issues: 灰黑死平底上一行 SPOTLIGHT ON 小字，标题本身像占位文案
光锥是一块硬边灰色梯形，光斑像贴上去的，场景里没有任何东西被照亮（墙、地面）
无衬线粗体 + 中性灰，没有情绪，读不出"聚光"的舞台感
全亮后 1 秒多完全静止、无任何附加信息
changes: look 自定义「velvet」：酒红黑天鹅绒幕布 + 钨丝暖白追光 + 香槟金点缀；标题换成 220px 衬线「Opening night.」（roman + italic 混排的剧院海报感），虚构票务产品 Balcony
光是物理的：灯头在画外正上方，追光像钟摆沿下凹弧线摆两个半来回、阻尼收拢，x 与速度同时归零停在正中；开灯有钨丝预热闪两下
光到哪里哪里亮：亮版标题（+ 柔晕）与亮版天鹅绒褶皱同一遮罩随光斑揭开，光束里有浮尘，台口地板上有落地光斑
全亮改为追光 iris 张开（360→1080px，out-cubic），光锥线性收成柔和顶光；随后眉题 FRIDAY · 8 PM · ROW F、副标题与品牌行依次入场
空间三层：幕布远景 → 标题中景 → 台沿与地板近景；hold 段浮尘与顶光呼吸保持画面活着，总长 170f
issuesEn: A small SPOTLIGHT ON on a dead flat grey-black, with a title that read like placeholder copy
The cone was a hard-edged grey trapezoid; the pool looked pasted on and nothing in the scene (wall, floor) was actually lit
Bold sans in neutral grey had no mood and no sense of a stage spotlight
After the full reveal it sat completely still for over a second with no extra information
changesEn: Custom velvet look: burgundy-black velvet curtain, warm tungsten follow-spot and champagne-gold accents; the title is a 220px serif Opening night. mixing roman and italic like a theatre poster, for a fictional ticketing app, Balcony

The light is physical: the lamp hangs above frame and the spot swings like a pendulum along a sagging arc for two and a half passes, damping so position and speed reach zero together at centre; the lamp flickers twice as the filament warms
Light reveals what it touches: a lit copy of the title (with soft glow) and of the velvet folds are uncovered by the same moving mask, with dust in the beam and a pool on the stage floor
The full reveal is now the follow-spot iris opening (360→1080px, out-cubic) while the cone fades linearly into a soft top light; then the FRIDAY · 8 PM · ROW F kicker, subtitle and brand line come in
Three depth layers: curtain, title, stage lip and floor; drifting dust and a breathing top light keep the hold alive; 170f total
